Verses.VerseAr: هَلۡ اَتٰى عَلَى الۡاِنۡسَانِ حِيۡنٌ مِّنَ الدَّهۡرِ لَمۡ يَكُنۡ شَيْئًا مَّذۡكُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely there has passed over man a period of time when he was not a thing worth mentioning.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ اَمۡشَاجٍۖ نَّبۡتَلِيۡهِ فَجَعَلۡنٰهُ سَمِيۡعًۢا بَصِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We created man from a fertilized ovum that We keep turning and examining (from one stage to the next till birth). So We have made him (in the order of) hearing (then) seeing.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا هَدَيۡنٰهُ السَّبِيۡلَ اِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَّاِمَّا كَفُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed We also showed him the way (to understanding and insight for distinguishing between the Truth and falsehood) whether he (now) becomes thankful or continues to be ungrateful.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّاۤ اَعۡتَدۡنَا لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ سَلٰسِلَا۟ وَاَغۡلٰلاً وَّسَعِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Verily We have prepared for the disbelievers chains (for the feet), neck-fetter and the Blazing Fire (of Hell).

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ الۡاَبۡرَارَ يَشۡرَبُوۡنَ مِنۡ كَاۡسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوۡرًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely the sincerely devoted and obedient will drink from the cups (of the holy drink) mixed with kafur (to enhance its aroma, colour and taste).

Verses.VerseAr: عَيۡنًا يَّشۡرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللّٰهِ يُفَجِّرُوۡنَهَا تَفۡجِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Kafur) is a spring (in Paradise) from which will drink (the privileged) servants of Allah (i.e. Awliya’ Allah) and will (also) make it flow to wherever they will desire in the form of small brooks (to make others drink of it).

Verses.VerseAr: يُوۡفُوۡنَ بِالنَّذۡرِ وَيَخَافُوۡنَ يَوۡمًا كَانَ شَرُّهٗ مُسۡتَطِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (These privileged servants of Allah are those) who fulfil their vows and keep fearing that Day whose severity spreads afar.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيُطۡعِمُوۡنَ الطَّعَامَ عَلٰى حُبِّهٖ مِسۡكِيۡنًا وَّيَتِيۡمًا وَّاَسِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they give (their own) food, in deep love of Allah, to the needy, the orphan and prisoner (out of sacrifice, despite their own desire and need for it),

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّمَا نُطۡعِمُكُمۡ لِـوَجۡهِ اللّٰهِ لَا نُرِيۡدُ مِنۡكُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّلَا شُكُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (And say:) ‘We are feeding you only to please Allah. We do not seek any recompense from you nor (wish for) any thanks.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنۡ رَّبِّنَا يَوۡمًا عَبُوۡسًا قَمۡطَرِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: We fear from our Lord the Day which will make (the faces) look very dark (and) ugly.’

Verses.VerseAr: فَوَقٰٮهُمُ اللّٰهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ الۡيَوۡمِ وَلَقّٰٮهُمۡ نَضۡرَةً وَّسُرُوۡرًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So Allah will save them from the terror of that Day (for their fear of Allah) and will grant them freshness, bloom and blush (on their faces) and ecstasy and delight (in their hearts),

Words.MeaningEn: and will cause them to meet

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَزٰٮهُمۡ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡا جَنَّةً وَّحَرِيۡرًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And will bless them with Gardens (to live in) and silky clothes (to wear), a reward for their patience.

Verses.VerseAr: مُّتَّكِـِٕـيۡنَ فِيۡهَا عَلَى الۡاَرَآٮِٕكِ‌ۚ لَا يَرَوۡنَ فِيۡهَا شَمۡسًا وَّلَا زَمۡهَرِيۡرًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Reclining in it against cushions on raised couches, they will find there neither intense cold nor heat.

Verses.VerseAr: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيۡهِمۡ ظِلٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتۡ قُطُوۡفُهَا تَذۡلِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And the shades (of trees in Paradise) will close upon them and the bunches of their (fruits) will be hanging low.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِاٰنِيَةٍ مِّنۡ فِضَّةٍ وَّاَكۡوَابٍ كَانَتۡ قَوَارِيۡرَا۟ؔ ۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And (the servants) will go round them with vessels of silver and (pure and clean) goblets of shining glass,

Verses.VerseAr: قَوَارِيۡرَا۟ؔ مِنۡ فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوۡهَا تَقۡدِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And glasses made of silver which they will have filled with exact measures (according to everyone’s desire).

Verses.VerseAr: وَيُسۡقَوۡنَ فِيۡهَا كَاۡسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنۡجَبِيۡلاً‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they will be made to drink there cups of (the holy drink) mixed with Zanjabil.

Words.MeaningEn: And they will be given to drink

Verses.VerseAr: عَيۡنًا فِيۡهَا تُسَمّٰى سَلۡسَبِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: (Zanjabil) is a spring in this (Paradise) named Salsabil.

Verses.VerseAr: وَيَطُوۡفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وِلۡدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُوۡنَ‌ۚ اِذَا رَاَيۡتَهُمۡ حَسِبۡتَهُمۡ لُـؤۡلُـؤًا مَّنۡثُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And going round them will be (innocent) adolescents who will remain ever-young. When you will see them you will take them as scattered pearls.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِذَا رَاَيۡتَ ثَمَّ رَاَيۡتَ نَعِيۡمًا وَّمُلۡكًا كَبِيۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And when you will look (at Paradise) you will find blessings (in abundance) and a mighty kingdom (all around).

Verses.VerseAr: عٰلِيَهُمۡ ثِيَابُ سُنۡدُسٍ خُضۡرٌ وَّاِسۡتَبۡرَقٌ‌ وَّحُلُّوۡۤا اَسَاوِرَ مِنۡ فِضَّةٍ ‌ۚوَسَقٰٮهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ شَرَابًا طَهُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: They will be clad in green fine silk and rich brocade attire, and they will be made to wear silver bracelets, and their Lord will make them drink a holy beverarge.

Words.MeaningEn: and will give them to drink

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ هٰذَا كَانَ لَـكُمۡ جَزَآءً وَّكَانَ سَعۡيُكُمۡ مَّشۡكُوۡرًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely that will be your reward and your hard work is acknowledged.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ تَنۡزِيۡلاً‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed We have revealed the Qur’an to you piecemeal.

Verses.VerseAr: فَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعۡ مِنۡهُمۡ اٰثِمًا اَوۡ كَفُوۡرًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: So (continue to) be patient for the sake of your Lord’s Command and do not give your ear to any liar, sinner or disbeliever or thankless person from among them.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاذۡكُرِ اسۡمَ رَبِّكَ بُكۡرَةً وَّاَصِيۡلاً   ۚ ۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمِنَ الَّيۡلِ فَاسۡجُدۡ لَهٗ وَسَبِّحۡهُ لَيۡلاً طَوِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And prostrate yourself before His Presence for some hours of the night and glorify Him during (the rest of) the long hours of the night.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّوۡنَ الۡعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُوۡنَ وَرَآءَهُمۡ يَوۡمًا ثَقِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely these (world-mongers) love the gains that are achievable right away. And they have put behind their backs (the remembrance of) the very hard Day.

Verses.VerseAr: نَّحۡنُ خَلَقۡنٰهُمۡ وَشَدَدۡنَاۤ اَسۡرَهُمۡ‌ۚ وَاِذَا شِئۡنَا بَدَّلۡنَاۤ اَمۡثَالَهُمۡ تَبۡدِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: (They do not realize that) We alone have created them and have made their every joint strong, and We can replace them whenever We may please with the people like them.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذۡكِرَةٌ   ‌ۚ فَمَنۡ شَآءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ سَبِيۡلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: Indeed this (Qur’an) is a Reminder. So whoever desires may adopt the way to (reach) his Lord.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَا تَشَآءُوۡنَ اِلَّاۤ اَنۡ يَّشَآءَ اللّٰهُ‌ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيۡمًا حَكِيۡمًاۖ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And you cannot wish anything yourselves except what Allah wills. Indeed Allah is All-Knowing, Most Wise.

Verses.VerseAr: يُّدۡخِلُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ فِىۡ رَحۡمَتِهٖ‌ؕ وَالظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا اَلِيۡمًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: He admits whom He wills to (the circle of) His Mercy and He has prepared a grievous torment for the wrongdoers.
